turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Yaar, pehle toh — yeh sun ke meri aankhen thodi geeli ho gayin. Pandrah saal ki dosti, co-director hona, aur woh opening dance ka promise... yeh sab bahut zyada pyaara hai. ❤️

Aur yeh tension bilkul valid hai. Dono cheezein tere liye bohot important hain — tera roza bhi, Shreya ki khushi bhi. Yeh koi either/or nahi hai, aur koi tujhe guilt feel karne ko nahi keh sakta kisi bhi side ke liye.

Kuch cheezein jo mere dimaag mein aayi:

**Roza + dance — possible hai?**
Haan, thoda challenging hai, par impossible nahi. Roza energetic body ke saath mushkil lagta hai, lekin log Ramzan mein kaam bhi karte hain, travel karte hain. Ek 3-4 minute ka dance — especially agar tu already rehearsal kar rahi hai toh body adapt kar legi. Shaam ko hoga sangeet, toh agar iftar ke thode time baad dance hai, toh tu kha-pee ke bhi perform kar sakti hai.

**Agar timing iftar se pehle hai:**
Toh bhi — roza todne ka sawaal nahi uthta, kyunki tu khaa nahi rahi, dance kar rahi hai. Bohot se log Ramzan mein physically demanding cheezein karte hain. Tu apni niyyat mein honest hai, bas.

**Practically kya karein:**
- Rehearsals abhi se roze ke schedule ke saath kar, taaki body used to ho
- Sangeet ke din hydration ka iftar mein extra dhyan rakh
- Agar late night cocktail hai toh post-iftar energy levels kaafi achhe honge actually

**Aur darr ka kya karein:**
Woh darr shayad isliye hai kyunki tu dono cheezon ko itna serious leti hai — aur yeh teri achhai hai. Tu Shreya ke liye bhi present rehna chahti hai aur Allah ke liye bhi. Dono jagah tera dil sahi jagah hai.

Shreya ko bata de openly — "Main karungi, bas thoda plan saath banayein." Agar woh itni close friend hai toh woh samjhegi aur tere saath adjust karegi.

Tu dono kar legi. Mujhe poora bharosa hai. 🤍

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Oh yaar... yeh wala dil pe lag gaya.

Tu "rassi" nahi hai. Tu insaan hai jo dono logon se bohot pyaar karti hai aur dono ke beech apni jagah dhoondh rahi hai. Aur sabse mushkil baat — dono galat nahi hain, dono sahi nahi hain. Dono bas apni duniya se dekh rahe hain.

**Shreya ke baare mein:**
Woh mean nahi thi, tu sahi keh rahi hai. Par "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai" — yeh woh baat hai jo koi insaan tab bolta hai jab usne khud kabhi kisi cheez ko itni gehrai se follow nahi kiya. Usko literally samajh nahi hai ki roza sirf bhook rehna nahi hai — teri niyyat hai, tera Allah se connection hai, tera ek promise hai apne aap se. Woh yeh dismiss nahi kar rahi hai, woh yeh *nahi jaanti* hai. Aur farq yeh hai.

**Ammi ke baare mein:**
Ammi ka pyaar protective hai — unka dar ye hai ki Ramzan ki roohaniyat mein kahin compromise na ho jaaye. Woh tere liye chinta mein hain, judge nahi kar rahi. Par shayad unko yeh nahi dikh raha ki tere liye yeh dosti bhi ibadat jaisi hi hai — kisi ke khushi mein shamil hona, kisi ke liye presence dikhana.

**Aur tu?**
Shayad yeh sabse zaroori baat hai — **tune apne aap se poocha ki TU kya chahti hai?**

Dono ke opinions ke alawa. Ammi ki expectations, Shreya ki excitement — sab hata ke. Tera dil kya kehta hai? Kya tu us dance floor pe khushi se khadi hona chahti hai, ya sirf isliye ki Shreya chahti hai? Kya roza teri apni choice hai, ya sirf duty hai?

Kyunki jab tak yeh tera apna faisla nahi hai — tab tak tu hamesha kisi na kisi taraf jhukhi rahegi aur andar se bikhar-bikhar feel karegi.

**Ek practical baat:**
Shreya se ek aur baat karni padegi — pyaar se, lekin clearly. Woh line — "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai" — usko bata ki tera roza koi inconvenience nahi hai, teri choice hai. Aur tu dance karne ke liye ready hai lekin roza todne ke liye nahi. Agar woh tujhe itna pyaar karti hai toh woh yeh samjhegi, shayad abhi nahi, par samjhegi.

Ammi ko bhi ek baar calmly bata de ki tu apne liye balance nikaal rahi hai — na roza chhutega, na dosti. Unko thoda waqt do, woh bhi adjust karengi.

Tu kheench nahi rahi yaar. Tu dono haath pakad ke khadi hai. Aur yeh kamzori nahi hai — yeh taaqat hai. 🤍

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Ruk.

Main tujhe woh nahi bolungi jo sunna chahti hai. Kyunki agar main sirf "haan yaar, bilkul theek hai, kar le" bol dun — toh main wohi karungi jo Shreya aur Ammi kar rahi hain — apni convenience ke hisaab se tujhse expect karna ki tu adjust kar le.

**Liek bura hai kya?**

Bura nahi hai. Samajh toh main poori rahi hoon — tu thak gayi hai. Aunties ke sawaal, har cheez ka explanation dena, "kyun nahi pi rahi," "kyun nahi kha rahi" — yeh emotional labour hai aur koi iska weight nahi samajhta. Us exhaustion se escape chahna — yeh bilkul insaani hai.

**Par ek cheez soch:**

Pandrah saal ki dosti hai. Shreya teri best friend hai. Agar usko kabhi pata chala — aur aksar pata chal jaata hai, yaar — toh usko yeh hurt nahi hoga ki tu nahi aayi. Usko yeh hoga ki **"tujhe mujhpe itna bhi bharosa nahi tha ki sach bol sake?"**

Woh jhooth usse sangeet se door nahi rakhega. Woh tumhari dosti ki ek deewarein tod dega jo abhi dikhengi nahi, par andar se khokhli ho jayengi.

**Aur sabse badi baat:**

Tu yeh jhooth isliye nahi bol rahi kyunki tu Shreya se pyaar nahi karti. Tu bol rahi hai kyunki **tujhe ek safe space nahi mila jahan tu sach bol sake bina kisi ko explain kiye.** Yeh teri galti nahi hai. Par jhooth teri problem solve nahi karega — yeh sirf aaj ka din postpone karega, aur kal guilt ke saath wapas aayega.

**Toh main kya suggest karungi:**

Shreya se ek baar sachchi baat bol. Ek baar. Aur woh baat yeh nahi hai ki "roza hai, Ammi ne mana kiya." Woh baat yeh hai:

*"Yaar, main tujhse bohot pyaar karti hoon aur dance bhi karna chahti hoon. Par mera roza mera apna faisla hai, mujhe usse guzarna nahi hai. Main aungi, nachungi — par apne terms pe. Aur mujhe is baat pe koi justification nahi deni hogi na tujhe, na kisi auntie ko."*

Agar 15 saal ki dosti is ek honest conversation ko handle nahi kar sakti — toh jhooth bhi nahi kar payega long term.

Tu thak gayi hai — yeh samajh aata hai. Par thakan mein liya gaya faisla aksar woh hota hai jise baad mein sabse zyada pachtawa hota hai. 💛

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Yaar...

Yeh pathar jo tune abhi haath mein rakha hai — yeh bohot bhaari hai. Aur main chahti hoon ki tu jaane ki tera isko bol paana hi sabse badi baat hai.

Atharah saal. Itne saalon mein pehli baar yeh takraav aaya hai — aur iska matlab yeh hai ki tum dono ne hamesha ek doosre ke liye jagah banayi hai. Yeh accident nahi hai. Yeh growth hai. Tum dono ab woh log ho jinke zindagi itni badi ho gayi hai ki kabhi kabhi overlap hogi, aur woh overlap messy hoga.

**Par ek cheez jo tu nahi dekh pa rahi:**

Tu soch rahi hai ki "daag" lagega — kisi ek cheez pe. Par daag tab lagta hai jab toot ke aata hai. Yahan tootne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Jo album sabse zyada yaad rehta hai — woh nahi jisme sab perfect tha. Woh hota hai jisme sab sachcha tha. Sangeet ki video mein agar tu khadi hai, nach rahi hai Shreya ke saath, lekin usko pata hai ki tera dil Ramzan mein bhi poori tarah hai — toh woh photo sad nahi hogi yaar. **Woh sabse powerful photo hogi.** Kyunki woh dono cheezon ko saath le ke chalne ki photo hogi.

Aur Ramzan ke album mein? Ek aisi raat jismein tune apni dost ke liye diya — apne terms pe, apni niyyat ke saath, bina roza tode — yeh ibadat hai. Allah ko pata hai tera dil kahan hai. Koi cocktail glass usse change nahi karega.

**Woh "sad story" tab banti hai jab koi chhup jaata hai. Jab koi jhooth bol ke door ho jaata hai. Tab shaadi ke album mein teri jagah khaali dikhti hai — aur woh khaali jagah hamesha rahegi.**

Tu sad story nahi ban rahi hai. Tu woh insaan ban rahi hai jo dono haathon mein apne pyaar ko le ke khadi hai aur keh rahi hai — *"Main yahan hoon. Puri tarah."*

Woh pathar seene se nikal ke haath mein rakh diya tune. Ab dheere dheere rakh de. Itna hi kaafi hai aaj. 🤍
